name: ilm
description: Ilm (علم) — sacred text comparison and knowledge platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ilm/shared && npm run build -w @ilm/api && npm run build -w @ilm/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.db:up: docker run -d --rm --name ilm-postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=ilm -e POSTGRES_USER=postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -p 5433:5432 -v ilm_postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d ilm" --health-interval 5s --health-retries 10 postgres:16-alpine
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ilm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ilm/api && npm run typecheck -w @ilm/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @ilm/api && npm run lint -w @ilm/web
